/tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos/ /skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni/ /go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur/ /gang gis spyod pa mchog 'di la/ /blo gros shin tu mi g.yo bas/ /sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi/ /ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur/ /bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis/ /rnyed pa bla med de ring rnyed/ /gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa/ / bdag nyid chen po thams cad kya ི / /bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun/ /yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin pa/ /de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du/ /legs pa nyid du 'gro bar 'gyur/ /theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i/ /lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan/ khyed rnams der ni dong bas na/ /rang byung skal pa chen po pa/ /'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur/ /zhes pas spro ba brtan par byas nas/ dhīḥdang ha las byung ba'i ku sha sngas dang stan gyi phyir blangs la/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + de nas ) tshogs kyi 'khor los phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod do/ /lhag ma'i cho ga byas la 'das pa'i gtor ma ma gtogs pa rnams btang nas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod cing bstod pas rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor rang gi lus kyi dkyil 'khor la bstim nas/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsdus la nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis

gnas par bya'o/ /sta gon no/ /nangs par ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs la/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bri ba'i tshul/ rje btsun rin po ches mdzad pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga ltar shes par byas la/ 'dir ras bris la brten pa'i tshul ni/ phyem red gyi tshe/ tshom bu'i gzhi de nyid ¡Ã la ( ¡¶ lu ¡· kyi khor yug rnams ) ba byung lnga dri bzangs bdud rtsi ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + lnga ) dang bcas pas legs par byugs pa'i steng du gzhi bzang po bting ba la/ dkyil 'khor 'jig rten las 'das pa'i shar phyogs su zhal bstan nas bkram la/ khor yug kun tu mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma la sogs pa phun sum tshogs pa bsham mo/ /de nas sngon du 'gro ¡Ã ba'i gtor ma nas ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ba nas brtsams te ) mchod pa byin gyis brlabs pa'i bar sta gon bzhin byas la/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān na maḥsarba ta thā ga te ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + bh+yo ) la sogs pas der 'dus pa'i bgegs rnams la gtor ma lan gsum byin nas/ bgegs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par song shig ces brjod pa zhi ba dang*/ sum+bha'i sngags brjod cing ting lo dang chang bu byin nas bskrad pa zhi drag phyed ma dang*/ gu gul gyis bdug cing yungs dkar gyis brabs la | sum+bha la sogs pa drag po'i sngags brjod nas/ gang dag mi 'gro ba de dag gi mgo bo tshal pa brgyar 'gas par bya'o/ /zhes brjod pa drag po 'ba' zhig gis bgegs sbyangs nas/ rang gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad kaṃ gi rnam pas sna bug nas 'thon pa g.yas su ye shes kyi me dang*/ g.yon du rgya mtshor dor bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sar+b+ba pā paṃ da ha na bha smiṅku ru swā hā | zhes yang yang brjod pas sdig pa sbyangs shing*/ dkyil 'khor gyis tshon dang 'bags btsog la sogs pa sbyang ba'i phyir me long gi nang du gzugs brnyan shar ba la/ las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus bkru zhing*/

ji ltar bltams pa la sogs pa'i tshigs bcad dang*/ sngags kyi mthar chu'i rdul bsal bar bsam zhing | oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsa kra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa la tsa kra sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya bi sho dha ne swā hā/ zhes brjod do/ /dar la sogs pas phyis pas dri ma sbyangs/ de nas swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'phros pa'i 'od las srung ba'i 'khor lo rdzogs par bskyed pa'i nang du lam̐ las sa/ bam̐ las chu/ ram̐ las me/ yam̐ las rlung*/ sum̐ las ri rab/ thig le ser pos mtshan pa rnams 'dres pa las byung ba'i gzhal yas khang 'khor lo rim pa bzhin gdan rnams dang bum pa brgyad dang bcas zhing dur khrod brgyad kyis bskor ba bskyed la/ g.yon pa'i srin lag gis reg nas pū dza la sogs pa brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas lha'i gnas rnams su mngon byang sum cu rtsa bdun las lha rnams dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las bdud rtsis gang ba'i thod pa bzhi bskyed la/ go cha gnyis bcings nas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor rang la bstim pa/ mdun du phyung ba la mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs mdun bskyed la bstim mo/ /slar yang ye shes pa bstim zhing dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab bo/ /de nas byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir dbyu gu'i rtser rdo rje btags pas lha rnams la reg cing thog mar gtso bo yab yum la snying po gnyis dang lha gzhan rnams la rang sngags dang thod pa bzhi dang dur khrod rnams la oṃ āḥhūm̐ brjod pas byin gyis brlab bo/ /de bzhin du gnyis pa la yum gyi nye snying dang*/ gsum pa la sgo ma bzhi'i phreng sngags dang*/ bzhi pa la ā li dang*/ lnga pa la kā li dang*/ drug pa la yi ge brgya pa brjod cing byin gyis brlab bo/ /dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'o/ /de nas sngags kyi mchod pa nas brtsams te mchod pa rgyas pa dang*/

bstod pa dang*/ gtor ma'i bar bya ba ni mchod pa'o/ /de nas rang nyid khrus dang gtsang sbra sngon du song nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'dug la bla ma dang gtso bo tha mi dad pa'i mdun du dbang blangs te/ bla mas mdzad rgyu rnams des mdzad la/ las kyi bya ba rnams de'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i he ru ka phyag gnyis pas mdzad cing slob ma'i bya ba rnams rang gis dngos su bya'o/ /de'ang maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar ba la/ bla mas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ / rgyu dang las las yang dag byung*/ /de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*/ /bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni/ /gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams/ /kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces lan gsum gyis bden pa'i stobs brjod nas a kham̐ wi ra hūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs bcing zhing me tog gi phreng ba gtad las thams cad pa'i chu dang sum+bhas bsangs/ bdud rtsi lce la bzhag cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ bu khyod su yin ci la dga'/ /zhes dris pa'i lan du// skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o/ /zhes pa dang*/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya// zhes pa'i lan du/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go /zhes lan btab nas/ rang gi snying gi nang du kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo ba ོ zla ba'i steng du/ don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa bsams nas/ dngos su rdo rjes gtug cing*/ oṃ ¡Ã sarba ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· badz+ra ) yo ga tsit+ta ut+pa dā yā mi/ su ra ti sa ma ya s+t+waṃ hoḥsid+dhi badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes pas byang chub kyi sems bskyed nas/ spyi bor rdo rje gtugs la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlob par 'gyur gyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang ba dam pa 'di/de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams la smra bar mi bya ste/

ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no/ /zhes pas gsang bar gdams nas | sgo mas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs kyi sgo drung du khrid par bsam zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod do/ /phyi'i 'jug pa'o// //de nas rang nyid skad cig gis he ru ka zhal gcig phyag gnyis par mos nas go cha gnyis bcings la gtso bo dang lu gu rgyud kyi phyag rgya sbrail nas rgyud bskul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ shrī he ru ka bid ma he/ bid+yā rā dzā ya dhi ma he swā hā/ zhes brjod pas bskul lo/ /de nas/ gang gi drin gyi bde chen nyid/ /skad cig nyid la 'char ba gang*/ /bla ma rin chen lta bu'i sku/ /rdo rje can zhabs pad la 'dud | | sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku/ /slob dpon la ni bdag skyabs mchi | | zhes pas bla ma dang*/ dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma 'khor lo/ /rnal 'byor gnas la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes pas dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la skyabs su song nas/ don dam smra ba'i seng ge rnal 'byor zhes bya ba/ /nyon mongs gcod pa'i don la shin tu mkhas gyur pa/ /srid pa'i nyes brgya skyed rtsa nyon mongs gcod mdzod la/ /rnal 'byor don dam rgyal po de nyid bdag la grub par mdzod | | ces pas gsol ba gdab pa rnams lan gsum du bya'o/ /de nas bla mas | de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas/ /he ru dpal grong khyer mchog / snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni/ /bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi bgegs dang sdig pa dang*/ dri ma sbyangs nas/ swa bhā was mi dmigs pa'i ngang las/ mngon par byang chub pa ¡Ã lnga'am ( ¡¶ zha ¡· 'am ) / rang skad cig gis dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo phyag bcu gnyis pa yum dang gnyis su med par gyur pa la/ go cha bcings nas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad ā li dang kā li'i rnam pas bdag la thim zhing bla mas ā li kā li brjod pas byin gyis brlab par bsgom pa ni nang du 'jug pa'i dngos gzhi'o//

//de nas dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs nas dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying gar thal mo sbyar zhing*/ na ma sti hūm̐/ na mā mi hūm̐/ na mo na maḥhūm̐/ zhes pa rkang pa re brjod pa dang*/ phyag re 'tshal zhing bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyi sku gsung thugs la phyag 'tshal bar bsam mo/ /de nas 'jug pa'i don du rnal 'byor pas shar sgo nas rang mkha' 'gro mar dmigs te/ spyi bor thal mo sbyar la | oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dza u pas+tha nā ya ād+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī ād+ma ḍā ki nī a dhi tiṣ+ṭha swa māṃ zhes pa dang*/ byang nas lā mār dmigs te dpral bar thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dza ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + ya ) a bhi ṣe kā ya ād+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī ād+ma lā mā abhi ṣiñca tu māṃ zhes pa dang*/ nub nas khaṇ+ḍa ro hār dmigs te/ mgrin par thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dza pra warta nā ya ād+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī ād+ma khaṇ+ḍa ro hā dharmā tsakra war+t+ta na ya māṃ/ zhes pa dang*/ lho nas gzugs can mar dmigs te/ spyi gtsug tu thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ sarba bī ra yo gi nī pū dza karma nā pū dza karma ṇi ād+ma naṃ nir+yā ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta bī ra yo gi nī ād+ma rū pi nī karma ku ru māṃ/ zhes brjod cing phyag re re bya'o/ /de nas rang nyid shar sgor 'dug pa la bla mas/ gong nas gong ma'i sdom pa ni/ /bu khyod kyis ni bsrung bya ste/ /grol ba'i rgyu ni de las gzhan/ /thabs ni ci yang yod ma yin | | zhes dam tshig spyir bsgrags pa dang*/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun ta ེ| | dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song*/ /'di ni sangs rgyas rigs ¡Ã yid 'ong ( ¡¶ lu ¡· dag pa'i ) / /sdom pa brtan par gyur pa'o/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya ni | | blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar bya/

/byang chub sems gang de rdo rje/ /shes rab dril bu zhes bsgrags so/ /blo chen khyod kyisagazung bar bya/ /bla ma sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam/ /'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig sdom pa yin par bshad/ /rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni/ /nyin re zhing yang lan drug tu/ / zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin/ /phyi dang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos ni ma lus gzung*/ /'di ni pad+ma'i rigs dag pa'i/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong ba'o/ /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la | | sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /yang dag nyid du gzung bar bya/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus gyis/ /zhes pas dam tshig so sor bsgrags nas/ sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /la sogs pa bdag nyid kyis lan gsum brjod pas rigs lnga'i sdom pa spyi dang sngar bshad pa'i khyad par gyi dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyang blang ngo*/ /de ltar thob pa'i dam tshig mi nyams par bsrung du gzhug pa'i phyir/ bla mas ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta ci smos/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re zhes bsrungs pa'i phan yon dang*/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /snying la yang dag zhugs par 'gyur/ /gal te tshul 'di smras na ni/ /de ma thag tu dral te gshegs | | zhes ma bsrungs pa'i nyes dmigs dang*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu/ /dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed/ /dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni | | rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub/ /oṃ pañca a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥ hūm̐ | zhes brjod nas bdud rtsi blud pa phan yon dang*/ nyes dmigs gnyis ka dang | deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyis/

gang ngas 'di byos shig ces bsgo ba de bya dgos so/ khyod kyis nga la brnyas par ma byed cig byas na khyod mi bde ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes rdo rje slob dpon gyi bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la bzhag cing bdag gis bka' bzhin bsgrub par khas blangs par bsam mo/ /de nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab tu gsol/ zhes lan gsum gyis ye shes dbab par gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas dngos po dang mtshan ma la ma zhen pa'i ngang las rang nyid yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor has mtshan pa'i steng na gnas pa'i he ru ka phyag ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + bcu ) gnyis pa/ zhabs gnyis bgrad nas bzhengs pa'i rkang mthil gnyis su dzhaiṃ dmar po me'i rang bzhin/ sum mdor ram̐ las me gru gsum/ snying gar lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par bam̐ las chu dkar po zlum po as mtshan pa/ spyi bor yam̐ las rlung zla gam has mtshan pa dmigs nas 'og gi rlung g.yos pas dzhaiṃ 'bar ba'i me sum mdo'i me dang 'dres pa'i me lces lus thams cad gang bas sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad bsreg sa dmar por tshig chu bskol bas 'og dang steng gi rlung gis bteg cing mnan/ me'i 'od phyogs bcur 'phros pa'i dkyil 'khor kyi lha thams cad dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad char bzhin du babs pas lus thams cad gang bar bsam zhing*/ dngos su gu gul la sogs pas bdug bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis yab yum kyi snying po dang*/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha ma hā kro dha ā we sha ya hūm̐/ oṃ shrī he ru ka bid ma he bid+yā rā dzā ya dhi ma he swā hā/ zhes bsgrags par bsam zhing yid gzung ngo*/ /de nas spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas tiṣ+ṭha badz+ras brtan par mdzad par bsam/ ye shes dbab pa'o/ /de nas bla mas/

lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*/ /bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur/ /'di la bsod nams ci yod pa//dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces lan gsum gyis lha la gsol ba btab nas/ rang gi me tog bzung nas dkyil 'khor la bltas pa'i kha dog ¡Ã sna tshogs pas ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· snang bas ) las gang 'grub brtags la/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥs sngar phog pa'i lha la me tog dbul lo/ /de nas pra ti gṛh+ṇa swa mi maṃ satwa ma hā ba la oṃ/ zhes gsung zhing me tog mgor bzhag nas rang gi mig 'bras gnyis su oṃ bskyed la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi/ /mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad/ /phye bas thams cad mthong gyur pa/ /rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med/ /oṃ badz+ra ni tra ā pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hriḥzhes pas gdong g.yogs phye nas/ dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos/ /da ni dad pa rab tu skyed/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes | | sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin gyis brlabs / /'gro ba phun sum tshogs kun dang | | dngos grub khyod kun mngon du 'gyur/

/dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang | | sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis/ /zhes pas dkyil 'khor spyi dang*/ sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar bzhugs/ /gnyis med gnyis med pang na gnas/ / brtan g.yo kun gyi bdag nyid can/ /spyod ( ¡¶ zha ¡· gcod ) dang grol bar rab brtson pa/ /kun mkhyen kun mdzad gtso bo ste/ /dpa' bo che la bu khyod ltos/ / zhes pas gtso bo lhag par bstan nas/ rang gis kyang blta zhing dkyil gyi 'khor lo dngos su mthong snyam du nges shes skyed pa ni nang du 'jug pa ste/ dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa'o// //de nas dbang blang ba'i phyir maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba/ /'gro ba skyob phyir gzi brjid can/ /ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso | | de bzhin bdag la'ang deng stsol zhig /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi shar du rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs pa'i dpal he ru kar dmigs pa'i steng du gdugs dkar po dang phyogs thams cad nas mchod pa sna tshogs kyis mchod par bsam zhing gtso bo'i thugs ka nas spros pa'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad kyis bgegs thams cad bskrad/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod/ bkra shis brjod cing khrus gsol te/ me tog gi char chen po phab pas shis pa mdzad par bsam mo/ /de nas gtso bo yab yum gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas rang gi ¡Ã snying gar ( ¡¶ zha ¡· khar ) zhugs nas snying ga'i hūm̐ gi mtha' mar g.yon skor du bkod pas | sngags kyi dbang thams cad thob par bsam zhing*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba ra swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā | zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi/ / bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes lan gsum brjod nas me tog slar phul/ gtso bos phreng ba de nyid sngags su byin gyis brlabs nas/

bcom ldan 'di la rtsal lags kyi/ /bcom ldan 'di la byin gyis rlobs/ /zhes gsung zhing me tog spyi bor bzhag par bsam pa ni sngags kyi dbang ngo*/ /de nas rig pa'i dbang lnga blang ba'i phyir bdag dang rnam rgyal gyi bum pa swa bhā was sbyangs pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang ¡Ã zla ba'i ( ¡¶ lu ¡· nyi ma'i ) steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can thams cad gyi don byas/ slar 'dus pas mi bskyod pa sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa'i dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥsnying gar hūm̐ bkod nas dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥdabang rdzas kyi mi bskyod pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs nas zhu ba las byung ba'i chur bltas la | dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams la/ khyed kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sprul pa'i dbang gi lha drug cu rtsa gnyis nam mkhar byon nas gtso bos/ ji ltar bltams pa la sogs pa dang*/ a bhi ṣe ka ta'i sngags kyi mthar oṃ kā kā s+ye/ u lū kā s+ye/ shwa nā s+ye | sū ka rā s+ye/ ya ma da dhī/ ya ma dū tī/ ya ma daṃṣ+t+rī ṇī/ ya ma mā tha nī/ oṃ badz+rī bhā wa a bhi ṣiñca hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ snying po'i rnal 'byor ma bzhis rdo rje'i glu len/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor rnams kyis bkra shis brjod/ sgo mtshams ma rnams kyis bgegs bskrad cing mchod nas dbang gi chu rgyun des rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa ni phyi'i dbang ngo*/ /snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas | sangs rgyas thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas spyan drangs pa snying ga'i sgo nas lus la thim pas/ bdag mi bskyod pa'i ngo bor gyur pa ni nang gi dbang ngo

| | de nas dngos su mchod nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang rnam par dag rnam shes gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes dang*/ mi bskyod pa'i dngos grub thob par bsam mo/ /'od kyi spro bsdu las bskyed pa dang*/ dbang rdzas kyi ting nge 'dzin dang | yum rnams kyi phyag mtshan dang*/ gnyis ka'i rgyan dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ dbang gi ¡Ã lha rdzogs pas ( ¡¶ lu ¡· lhas ) dbang gi las mdzad pa rnams ni/ dbang 'og ma rnams la'ang so sor sbyar zhing shes par bya'o/ /ām̐ las rin po che ām̐ gis mtshan pa las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum rin chen sgrol ma dang sbyor bar dmigs nas/ dbang gis lhas/ ral pa'i thor gtsug gis brgyan pa'i/ /rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang*/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis bsngags pa yi/ /dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya/ /zhes pa'i mthar yum gyi nye snying dang*/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha ma hā mu ku ṭa ho/ zhes pas dbu rgyan dang*/ chu la sogs pas sngar bzhin du dbang bskur/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan nas dpral ba'i am̐ las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas rnams rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rnam par ( ¡¶ zha ¡· pas ) spyan drangs pa dpral ba nas lus la thim pas/ rang nyid rin chen 'byung ldan gyi ngo bor gyur pa la mchod nas/ cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid dang rin chen 'byung ldan gyi dngos grub thob par bsam mo// //dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dz+rīṃ gis mtshan pa las 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum gos dkar mo dang sbyor bar dmigs nas dbang gi lhas | 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /he ru ka dpal dbang bskur bas/ /de ring khyod ni dbang bskur te/ /rab tu grub phyir rdo rje zungs/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti staṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi tiṣ+ṭha ¡Ã bī ra

( ¡¶ zha ¡· badz+ra ) sa mā ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i rdo rje gnang ba blangs te/ snying gar bzung ba la chu la sogs pas dbang bskur bas 'od dpag tu med pas dbu brgyan nas/ mgrin pa'i dz+rīṃ las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad 'od dpag med kyi rnam par spyan drangs pa mgrin pa nas lus la thim pas rang nyid 'od dpag med kyi ngo bor gyur pa la mchod nas rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dag 'du shes gnas gyur | so sor rtog pa dang*/ 'od dpag tu med pa'i dngos grub thob par bsam mo || || khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa las don yod grub pa ljang gu ral gri dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum dam tshig sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor bar dmigs nas dbang gi lhas/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma kun gyi/ /shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*/ /byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed/ /badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥzhes pas byin gyis brlabs pa'i dril bu gnang ba lag pa g.yon pas dkrol la/ chu la sogs pas dbang bskur bas don yod grub pas dbur brgyan nas mtshog ma'i kham̐ las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad don yod grub pa'i rnam par spyan drangs pa mtshog ma nas lus la thim pas/ rang nyid don yod grub pa'i ngo bor gyur pa la mchod nas/ dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa dang*/ don yod grub pa'i dngos grub thob par bsam mo// //bh+rūṃ las 'khor lo bh+rūṃ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dang sbyor bar dmigs nas dbang gi lhas/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñca mi shrī he ru ka nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /zhes dbang bskur te/ 'di la dbang rdzas med do/ /yang chu la sogs pas dbang bskur

| rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan nas spyi bo'i bh+rūṃ las 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas thams cad rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam pas spyan drangs pa spyi bo ¡Ã nas lus thams cad la thim pas/ rang nyid rnam par snang mdzad kyi rang bzhin du gyur pa la mchod nas/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· oṃ mgo thur bltas bsgoms pa'i bu gar bstims te/ lus thams cad de'i rdul phra rab kyi gang bar bsam mo/ /nang gi dbang ngo / / de nas mchod pa lngas mchod/ bshad pa ni ) ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings dang rnam par snang mdzad kyi dngos grub thob par bsam mo/ / rig pa'i dbang lnga'o// // de nas pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum rdo rje snyems ma dang sbyor bar dmigs nas/ dbang gi lhas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de/ /he ru ka dpal phyag na gnas/ khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zungs/ /he ru ka dpal brtul zhugs brtan/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ras mā ya tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra e ṣa s+t+waṃ dha ra yā mi hūm̐ hi hi hi hi hoḥzhes pas rdo rje gnang ba snying gar bzung la/ snying gi nang du yang de lta bu'i rdo rje sems dpa' bsgom pa ni rdo rje'i brtul zhugs so/ /yang pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las rang nyid 'khor lo bde mchog phyag bcu gnyis pa yum rdo rje phag mo dang gnyis su med par dmigs nas dbang gi lhas/ kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang ḍa ma ru/ /he ru ka dpal kha ṭ+wāṃ ga /rnal 'byor ma ni ḍa ma ru/ /rdo rje kha ṭ+wāṃ rdo rjer bcas/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing*/ / tshangs pa'i skud thogs rnal 'byor bdag kha ṭ+wāṃ ga dang rnal 'byor snod/ /dpa' bo chen po blang bar gyis/ /zhes pas g.yas pas ḍa ma ru/ g.yon pas thod pa/ gru mor kha ṭ+wāṃ ga se ral khar tshangs pa'i skud pas bcings nas snying ga'i nang du yang de lta bu'i he ru ka bsgoms pa ni thun mong ma yin pa'i brtul zhugs te slob ma'i dbang ngo*/

/de nas maṇ+ḍal phul la/ dpa' bo chen po mi ldog pa'i/ /dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol/ /sems can kun gya ི don gyi phyir/ /rdo rje slob dpon bdag gyur mdzod/ /ces lan gsum gyis rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du gsol ba btab nas/ dbang stegs rin po che'i khri seng ges bteg pa pad+ma dang nyi mar mos pa'i steng du rang gi shes pa hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus gcig tu 'dres pa las rang nyid rdo rje 'chang chen po sku mdog sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba/ yum rdo rje snyems ma sku mdog sngon mo gṛ gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka'ang rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan par gyur pa la/ go cha gnyis bcings te/ dbang gi lha thams cad kyis/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /la sogs pa sngags dang bcas pas lag pa g.yas par rdo rje byin nas/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che/ /kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid/ /rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag | ces de kho na nyid gsungs shing dran pas rang gi sems thugs rdo rje dang*/'di ni rnal 'byor ma ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + kun gyi ) la sogs pas dril bu ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + lag pa ) g.yon du byin nas/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ¡Ã dpa' ni ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ldan pa ) / /srid pa'i dam pa byed par 'gyur/ /zhes de kho na nyid gsung zhing dran pas rang gi sems gsung rdo rje dang*/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che/ /zungs shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs/ /de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis/ /'da' bar ru ni mi mdzad pa'i/ /dam tshig phyag rgya zhes su bshad/ /yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro/

/zhes phyag rgya'i de kho na nyid gsung zhing de'i don rang gis dran par byas pas lus sku rdo rjer gyur pa la snga ma bzhin bum pa'i chu la sogs pas dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dag slob dpon gyi bya ba mtha' dag la dbang bar byas nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa la dbang gi lha thams cad kyis/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing me tog gi char phab pas khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' phul bar bsam pa ni/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// // de nas bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi lha rnams kyis/ de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur/ /sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur par/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ /lha rnams kun gyis bzhed pa yin/ /sems can rnams ni rjes gzung phyir/ khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas ni/ /dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin bris nas/ /sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor/ /zhes slob dpon gyi bya ba'i rjes gnang dang*/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /rnal 'byor ma dang dpa' tshogs dang*/ /shes rab thabs bcas snyems can gyis/ /gar mchod bde ba'i dga' sngon ( ston ) gyis/ /āḥs sgeg mo dang*/ sgeg dang bcas pas phreng ba 'phang*/ /sangs rgyas kun sogs rnal 'byor ma/ /de ni 'bral bar mi 'gyur ro ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· te ) / /phraing ba de yi rgyan yin no/ /oṃ gyis phreng ba ma dang*/ lus can rnams la dam chos kyi/ /glu ni khyod kyi blang bar gyis/ /des ni rnal 'byor ma de dang*/ /myur du bde ba myong bar 'gyur/ /gīs glu ma dang*/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni/ /sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya/ /sangs rgyas 'du ba'i phrin las kyis/ /gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis/ /hoḥs gar ma dang*/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos legs tshim gyis | | lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su/ /ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis/ / āḥs bdug pa ma dang*/

sangs rgyas rnams la me tog dor/ /byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa/ /mtshan dang dpe byad ldan pa yi/ /bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyis | | bh+rūṃ gyi me tog ma dang*/ chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas/ /pad+ma gar dbang rang nyid de/ /sems can ma rig ldongs pa la/ /ye shes sgron me sbar bar gyis// pras mar me ma dang*/ khyod kyis rgyal la dri phul bas/ /tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*/ /rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi/ /byang chub lus can rnams la bsgos | | gas dri chab ma ste/ mchod pa'i rjes su gnang ba dang*/ /ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis/ /'jig rten rab rib bsal ba ltar/ /bu khyod kyis ni mi shes pa'i/ /rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal/ /oṃ badz+ra ni tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hriḥpraṃ/ zhes pas thur ma dang*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste/ /gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med/ /gzung du med cing brjod du med/ /rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*/ /ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa/ /de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la//sems can don ni mnyam med byos/ /des na rnal 'byor ma sras skye/ /zhes pas me long ste sems can gyi don bya ba'i rjes gnang dang*/

sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir/ /'jig rten du ni thams cad du/ /bya ba spyod tshul gsang ba yi/ / chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gyis/ /zhes pas 'khor lo dang*/ khyod kyis the tshom daugs med par/ /yid gnyis med pa sems kyis su/ /chos kyi dung ni bla med par/ /dri med kun tu gang bar gyis/ /zhes pas dung ste/ chos bshad pa'i rjes gnang dang*/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + sna tshogs rdo rje gnang nas/ ) zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar bya dang gnod sogs dang*/ /gsad dang bskrad pa thams cad de/ /las de rnams ni grub par gyis/ /ral gri mig sman sa 'og dang*/ /mchil l+h+wam de bzhin ri lu ste/ /rnal 'byor pa yi dngos grub ni | | de ni ci dgar grub par gyis/ /zhes pas phrin las te/ rjes su gnang ba rnams so/ /de nas dam tshig la gnyis las/ dam tshig dang sdom pa sbyin pa ni/ nangs par sngar langs sems dag nyid/ /ma lus par ni byas ¡Ã gyur kyang ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· nas su ) / /bsrung dang bza' ba la sogs pa'i/ /sdom pa'i bdag nyid can bsrung ngo*/ /lus dang srog la ltos med par/ /dam tshig dang ni sdom pa bsrung | | nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du/ /nyin re zhing ni bzlas par bya/ / gang tshe nyams na rnal 'byor pa/ kha na ma tho sbom por 'gyur/ /dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te/ /zla ba re re bsrung ba ni/ /gnyis med gnyis med la gnas pa | | tshes bcu la ni de rab mchod / /chang dang sha sogs gang ci'ang rung / /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma yi tshogs/ /thams cad gnyis med pang na gnas/ /he ru ka dpal rab tu mchod/ /theg pa dman la 'dod mi bya/ /sems can la yang rgyab mi phyogs/ /'khor ba dag kyang yongs mi spang*/ /mya ngan 'das la dgar mi 'gro/ /dpa' bo rnal 'byor ma kun la/ khyod kyis brnyas par mi bya ste/ / phyag rgya bzhon pa mtshon cha dang*/ /mtshan ma bgom par mi bya'o/ /dam tshig rab bsrungs bsod nams kyis/ /tshe 'di nyid la 'grub par

'gyur/ /bud med thams cad mthong ba na/ /g.yon nas lan gsum bskor bya zhing*/ /spyi bos phyag ni byas nas kyang*/ /lan gsum bar du gsol ba gdab/ /bdag ni ma khyod bu yin te/ /ji srid byang chub byung bar du/ /byang chub yan lag nu ma las/ /byung ba'i rang gi 'o mas skyongs/ /gnyis med ye shes spyod ldan pa'i/ /bslab pa blang ba sngon 'gro bas/ /sgra sogs stong pa sngon 'gro ba'i/ /tshangs par spyod pa shin tu bsrung*/ /dam tshig de la rtag gnas te/ /de sngon 'gro ba sbas pa'i yid//spyod dang grol ba'i gnas 'dod pa'i/ /yid la 'dod pa kun grub 'gyur/ /zhes bla mas dam tshig dang sdom pa gnang ba la/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal pa/ /de dag thams cad bdag gi bgyi/ /zhes rang gis sgrub par khas blangs nas/ gnyis pa bsrung ba'i dam tshig bkas gnang ba la gnyis las/ spyod pa dang*/ thun mong gi rjes su gnang ba ni/ gnyis med ye shes sems ldan pas/ /mi bya ba ni ci yang med/ /tshangs par spyod pa rtag mnos la/ /'dod pa lnga la spyod par gyis/ /gnyis med la gnas zas la ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs brdas | | gnyis med pa dang thogs med pa/ /dam tshig spyad pa spyod pa yin/ /sna tshogs dbang phyug legs spyad cing*/ /tshangs spyod bsam gtan de bzhin no/ khro ba med pa'i rgyun bcad pa'i/ /sgrub pa pos ni yongs su bsrung*/ /rtag tu sgrub la gnas nas ni/ /yul kun la ni rnal 'byor ma'i/ /gnyis med bsgrub pa'i rnal 'byor ma'o/ /mi brtan srog ni ji srid bar/ /bu khyod kyis ni ¡Ã bsgrub par ( ¡¶ zha ¡· bsrung bar ) bya/ /'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la/ /ci dga' bar ni longs spyod cig /he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor che/ /bsams nas thams cad rab tu brtag /bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad dang*/ /rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyi dngos/ /de bas 'bad pa thams cad kyis/ /he ru ka dpal bdag mchod do/ /zhes pa dang bsrung ba'i dam tshig dngos ni/

'dod chags bral ba lta bu yi/ khams gsum na ni sdig med de/ /de bas 'dod chags bral bar/ khyod kyis nam yang ma yin no/ /zhes pa rnams dam tshig dang sdom pa sbyin pa'o/ /de nas bla mas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgyas gtugs nas/ he ru ka dpal lung ston bzhin | | mgrin gcig tu ni thams cad kyis/ /'di ltar nga yis lung bstan te | | he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs/ /dngos grub mchog tu grub pa'i phyir | | srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton/ /he badz+ra aṃ ku ri/ shrī he ru ka che ge mo zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o/ /sid+dhi ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + badz+ra ) sa ma ya s+t+waṃ bhur+bhu wa swaḥ gang la tshigs su bcad pa 'dis don grub pa'i phyag rgyar gnas pa la mchog tu grub pa'i ¡Ã tshogs ( ¡¶ zha ¡· tshig gis ) mgrin gcig tu rgyal ba thams cad kyis lung ston par mdzad do/ /zhes pas lung bstan zhing gzengs bstod nas/ khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che/ /rgyal ba'i bdag por gnas pa dang*/ /der ni bdud las rnam rgyal zhing*/ /grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin/ /deng ni sangs rgyas nyid thob par/ khyed rnams the tshom med pa yin/ /dbang 'di bskur ba tsam gyis kyang*/ /slob ma yon tan bdag por 'gyur/ /slob dpon nyid kyi bde ba yis | | brtan g.yo kun gyi dam tshig yin/ /zhes pas dbugs phyung bar bsam mo | | de nas me tog yon du dmigs te phul nas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du/ khyed la bdag ni 'bul lags kyis/ khyed kyis slob mar gzung ba dang*//cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol/ /zhes lan gsum gyis gtang rag dbul lo/ / phyi dbyibs kyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa dang*/ dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis bsrung ba la dbang*/ sprul pa'i sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas par bsam mo/ / ¡Ã bum pa'i dbang ngo*/ / ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - bum pa'i dbang ngo*// ) de nas gsang ba'i dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/

bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye/ /rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa/ /mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po/ /rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*/ /ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che | | mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod/ /'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du/ /bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyob/ /ces lan gsum gsol ba btab nas | gdong g.yogs la 'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs te | bla ma dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo dang*/ gnyis su med pa yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug pa zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ gsang ba'i gnas nas thig le'i rnam par babs pas bdag gi lce thog tu gnang bar bsam zhing*/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis/ /byang chub sras la dbang bskur ltar/ /bdag gi gsang ba'i dbang gis ni/ /sems kyi rgyun gyi dbang bskur ro/ /'di ni byang chub grub rnal 'byor/ khams lnga bcud kyi bdag nyid can/ /he ru ka dpal bdag sbyor bas | | yang dag bde ba myang bar gyis/ /zhes gsungs nas gnang ba lce la myangs pas lus thams cad gang zhing*/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog 'gags nas gsung rnam par dag pa/ 'od dpag tu med par gyur par bsgoms la/ a ho ma hā su kham̐ zhes lan gsum brjod do/ /de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs phye nas/ byang chub sems kyi dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lam tsaṇ+ḍā lī bsgom pa la dbang*/ longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas par bsam mo/ /gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// //de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ tshig snga ma nyid kyis gsol ba btab la/ gdong g.yogs te/ 'bru gsum brjod cing byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang skad cig gis bde mchog phyag bcu gnyis par dmigs la bla mas/ dga' ster gnas ster lha mo ni/ /sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma/

khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che/ khyer la mchod pa dag tu gyis | | 'di ni byang chub grub rnal 'byor/ khams lnga bcud kyi bdag nyid can/ / he ru ka dpal rnal 'byor pas/ /yang dag bde ba myong bar gyis/ /deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyis/ /brtul zhugs bzang pos 'gro don gyis/ /bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dang*/ /dmangs rigs mthar skyes dag spyod cig / pad+ma'i bha gar tsum+ba dang*/ /bdud rtsi rnams ni legs grub kyis/ /zhes gsung zhing yongs su sbyangs pa'i phyag rgya byin nas lha mo des/ bram ze rgyal rigs rje'u rigs dang*/ /dmangs rigs mthar skyes bud med kun/ /gus dang bcas par mchod pa dang*/ /gnyis med tshul gyis tsum+ba na/ /dpa' bo khyod ni spro gyur tam/ / smos shig dpa' bo bde ba che/ /bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*/ khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te/ /sha chen bsten par bu spro 'am/ /zhes ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + phyag rgyas dris ) pa'i lan du/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + ji ltar gsungs pa'i dam tshig sogs/ /lha mo bdag ni cis mi spro/ /bud med rtag gus cis mi byed/ /pad+ma mchod par cis mi byed/ / ) ci gsung dam tshig bsten par ni/ / lha mo bdag gis byed par nus/ /zhes lan gdab pa dang*/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + lha mo de dgyes nas ) de pang du byon pa rdo rje phag mor gsal bar dmigs te/ sku gsung thugs dang gnas lnga dang*/ mkha' dang gsang ba byin gyis brlabs nas/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya snyam pas snyoms par zhugs pas 'khyud pa dang*/ tsum+ba'i tshe/ sna tshogs pa la dga' ba/ mnyam par sbyar ba'i tshe rnam smin la mchog dga'/ spyod pa dang ldan pa'i tshe rnam nyed la dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ bde stong zung du chud pa'i tshe mtshan nyid dang bral ba la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bar bsam/ de nyid kyi tshe yas 'bab kyi dga' ba bzhi dang*/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi mngon du byas nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ngang la mnyam par bzhag go

/de nas gdong g.yogs phye nas bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag pho nya'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ chos kyi sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas par bsam mo/ /shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*/ /de nas dbang bzhi pa'i don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ khyod zhabs pad+mo'i bka' drin gyis/ /gtso bo'i dbang bskur rnam gsum thob/ /de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*/ /bdag la bka' drin bskyab tu gsol/ /zhes ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + pa la sogs ) lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab/ gdong g.yogs la 'bru gsum brjod cing byin gyis brlabs te/ lus skyil krung lag pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya bcas pa la bla mas/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*/ /rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu/ /rdul bral mthar phyin zhi ba nyid/ khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do/ /zhes gsungs pa'i don dran par byas nas/ de la yid mnyam par bzhag la chos kyi sku'i ye shes skyes par bsam mo/ /de nas gdong g.yogs phye nas/ don dam byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ bag chags dang bcas pa'i dri ma thams cad dag bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas par bsam mo/ /dbang bzhi pa'o/ /de nas lus dang longs spyod thams cad yon du phul nas/ deng nas brtsams te la sogs pa gtang rag 'bul lo/ /de nas phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod pa'i phyir/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo/ lhag gtor bkra shis dang bcas pa'i bar cho ga las 'byung ba bzhin byas nas/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la slar yang mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ji ltar 'dod pa rnams gsol ba btab nas/ las bsags pa 'bras bu dang ldan par bya ba'i phyir/ bsngo ba dang smon lam yang rgya cher btab la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*/ /gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal pa/

/de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces pa dang*/ yi ge brgya pa yang brjod do// //dkyil 'khor la ma bstim pa'i lha tshogs rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /badz+ra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la bstim pa ni/ rab tu gnas pa mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir/ brtan par bzhugs su gsol zhing*/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams gshegs su gsol nas/ gtor ma nyid kyang rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas btang ste/ bdag nyid kyi cho ga gsum gyis bsrungs la/ las kyi rjes bsdus nas/ gnas skabs dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rnal 'byor gyis gnas par bya'o/ /de ltar rgyu'i dbang rtag tu lam du byed pa ni/ sgrib pa gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa sbyangs shing*/ tshogs gnyis yongs su rdzogs te/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bde ba thams cad la longs spyod de/ ring po mi thog par dbang phyug brgyad kyis phun sum tshogs pa'i rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang thob par 'gyur ba nyid do// // 'di la 'dun pa'i 'dun pas dbang byas 'dzam kyi ston pa zhes bya bas/ /ring nas bskul zhing bskul ba'i don du dge slong 'phags pas sbyar ba la/ /bdag blo'i nyes pas nyes gyur gang yin mkhyen ldan rnams la bdag gis bzod par gsol | | dge ba rnam dag rnam par bsags des bdag gzhan thams cad he ru kar gyur cig /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga 'di ni/ bla ma chos kyi rje sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhabs rdul spyi bos gus par blangs pa'i/ dge slong sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes bya bas | chu pho spre'u'i lo/ dbyar zla ra ba'i tshes gcig la/

g.yar mo thang gi sa'i cha shing kun tu sbyar ba'i ye ge pa ni a tsa ra zhes bya bas lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen byas nas sbyar ba 'di yongs su rdzogs so// // ༄༅/ / ¡Ã nag po pa'i ( ¡¶ zha ¡· dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i ) sgrub thabs snying po ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + gsal ba ) bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /dpal 'khor lo bde mchog gi mngon par rtogs pa sgrub pa'i thabs kyi snying po zhes bya ba/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo | | an+da rnyil dang in+d+ra nī la nye bar 'bar ba'i mdangs ldan zhing*/ /dum bu'i rgyan gyis dam du bcings zhing zhal dang phyag zhabs rnam par g.yo/ /rak+ta 'khyil ba'i rig mas dam 'khyud bde ba che la rnam rol pa/ /ha ha zhes bzhad he ru ka dpal 'bar ba'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang ba'i gsang ba bla na med/ /ma yi mar gyur rgyud sde yi/ /snying po'i snying po sgrub pa'i thabs/ /spyod pa'i rdo rjes su bstan/ /de lta mod kyi rtogs dka'i phyir/ /de don gsal bar gyis shig ces/ /don gnyer skye bos rab bskul bas/ /don de gsal bar bdag gis bshad/ /mnyam gzhag dang ni bzlas pa dang*/ /de bzhin gtor ma'i cho ga dang*/ /thun mtshams kyi ni bya ba ste/ /rnam pa bzhis ni bsdus pa yin/ /de la mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor la gnyis las/ thog mar bskyed pa'i rim pa'i bsgom tshul la gnyis/ rgyu tshogs gnyis bsags pa dang*/ 'bras bu lha bskyed pa'o/ /dang po la gnyis las/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa ni/ rang nyid stan bde ba la ci bde bar 'dug nas

bdud rtsi'i ri lu myang*/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi dang*/ byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ shrī he ru ka a haṃ zhes brjod la de'i don dran par byas pas ngag dag par bya/ snying gi nang du rnam par mi rtog pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo āḥlas byung ba'i zla ba dag pa 'jig rten pa dang thun mong pa'i ye shes su bsams pa'i steng du/ sems ye shes lnga'i bdag nyid kyi hūm̐ bsam pas yid dag par bya/ de'i 'od phog pas rang gi lus he ru kar ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + gyur ) dmigs pas lus dag par bya'o/ /de nas 'od kyi snang ba de nyid phyir 'phros pas bla ma brgyud pa dang bcas pa steng gi cha la gnas pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo mdun gyi nam mkhar bkug la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥzhes brjod pas bla ma dang*/ na maḥshrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa la bh+yaḥzhes pas dkyil 'khor la phyag bya'o/ /de nas mchod pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin mchod par bsam zhing | oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī tsakra sam+ba ra maṇ+ḍa la tsakra sarba bī ra yo gi nī zhes kun la sbyar la/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + ye ) swā hās mchod yon/ pā d+yaṃ pra ¡Ã tīts+tshas ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· ye swā hās ) zhabs bsil/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badz+ra dhūp+pe aḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri chab/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhal zas phul nas bdag pos ma bzung ba dang*/ blos sprul pa'i mchod pas mchod par bsam zhing dpral bar nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ na mo chos kyi dbyings kyi byin rlabs dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje rnam par dag pa'i byin rlabs dang*/ gsang sngags dang phyag rgya'i mthu dang*/ bdag gis mos pa dang*/ ting nge 'dzin dang smon lam gyi dbang gis/ 'jig rten gyi khams na bdag pos yongs su ma bzung ba'i mchod pa'i bye brag ji snyed yod pa dang*/

gzhan yang byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i rnam par thar pa las byung ba'i mchod pa'i sprin gyi phung po lta bu bsam gyis mi khyab pa zhig bla ma dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi spyan lam du 'byung zhing rgyas par gyur cig ces brjod la se gol brdab/ yang snying gar phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ sarba bid/ pu ra pu ra/ su ra su ra/ ā warta/ ā warta hoḥn maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ/ a bhi sma ra ya/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ/ dharma dhā tu ā kā sha sa man+ta maṃ/ sarba ta thā ga tā ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + a ) pa ri sho dha le/ ¡Ã maṇ+ḍa le ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - maṇ+ḍa le ) mā ma pra ṇi dhi/ pun+ya dz+nyā na ba ¡Ã le na ( ¡¶ zha ¡· len ta ) / sarba ta thā ga ta ¡Ã ba le na ( ¡¶ zha ¡· ban ta ¡¶ lu ¡· ta ) / ban+dha swa s+thā na ba le na tsa ye swā hā/ zhes brjod nas se gol brdabs la mchod pa bya'o/ /de nas brjod par 'gyur ba'i don dran par bya zhing*/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyi gzung | | sangs rgyas chos dang tshogs mchog la/ /byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi | | rang gzhan don ni rab bsgrub phyir/ /byang chub sems ni bskyed bar bgyi | | byang chub mchog gi sems ni bskyed bgyis nas/ /sems can thams cad bdag gis 'gron du gnyer/ /byang chub spyod mchog yid 'ong spyad par bgyi | | 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces lan gsum brjod nas | tshogs kyi zhing la bzod par gsol la gshegs su gsol/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags pa'o/ /de nas oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod nas chos thams cad sems kyi snang bar dran par bya/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dz+nyā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod nas sems kyang rang bzhin med par bsam mo/ /ye shes kyi tshogs bsags pa'o//

//gnyis pa 'bras bu lha bskyed pa la gsum/ dang po sbyor ba/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog las rgyal mchog go /dang po la gnyis las/ rten bskyed pa'i sngon du srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa ni/ stong pa'i ngang las/ rang gi sems kyi rnam 'phrul gyis sprul pa'i paṃ las pad+ma raṃ las nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ yig 'bar bas mtshan pa bltas la/ de la steng dang shar du khwa gdong gnyis dang | 'og dang nub tu khyi gdong ma gnyis dang bcas pa'i sgo mtshams ma rnams shar nas rim pa bzhin dang*/ shar lho nas rim pa las bzlog pa'i tshul gyis phyogs bcur spro bar bsam/ ngag tu zhal bzhi pa 'i sngags kyi rkang pa re re brjod do | | lus kyis g.yon pa'i se gol brdab pa rnams sbyar zhing bgegs thams cad bskrad par bsam mo/ /de nas hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ ra ba dang*/ gur dang*/ bla re dang*/ mda'i dra ba dang*/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba rnams su rim pa bzhin du gyur par bsam/ lus kyis g.yon pa'i sdigs mdzub phyogs bcur bskor la se gol brdab/ ngag tu oṃ me di nī badz+rī bha wa ban+dha hūm̐ ¡Ã hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ( ¡¶ lu ¡· laṃ hūm̐ ) / oṃ badz+ra prā kā ra hūm̐ bam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pañja ra hūm̐ yam̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra bi tā na hūm̐ kham̐ hūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra sa ra dz+wa la tram̐ sam̐ tram̐/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wā lā ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + a ) na lārka hūm̐ ram̐ hūm̐/ zhes pa brjod pa rnams lan gsum gsum brjod pa dang*/ rim pa bzhin sbyar zhing srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par bsgom ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + mo/ ) / de nas bgegs tshar gcad pa'i phyir hūm̐ las rdo rje phur bu'i tshogs spros/ pho nya rnams kyi lag pa g.yon par gtad/ rdo rje tho ba'i tshogs spros g.yas par gtad/ pho nya rnams rang rang dang 'dra ba'i sprul pa dpag tu med pas nam mkha' gang bar gyur pas/ phyogs skyong ba rnams kyis gtso byas pa'i bgegs rnams bkug

dkar po'i phyogs ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + rnams ) skyabs su 'gro ba dang byang chub kyi sems la bkod/ nag po'i phyogs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bu btab par bsgom ngag tu/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+tān phaṭa phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badz+ra kī la ya/ badz+ra dha ā dz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nān kā ya wā ka tsit+ta badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod do/ /rdo rje tho bas brdungs nas rdul du brlag par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra mut+ka ra badz+ra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod pas bgegs rnams kyi sdig pa sbyangs nas rnam shes mi bskyod pa'i zhing du skyes par bsam/ pho nya rnams rdo rje ra ba'i kha khyer la 'khod nas sgrub pa po sangs ma rgyas kyi bar du srung bar bsam mo/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom pa'i rim pa'o// // de nas rten bskyed pa'i phyir srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du/ e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum gdengs kha gyen du phyogs pa'i nang du rim pa bzhin du lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po/ bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po/ ram̐ las me'i dkyil 'khor gru gsum dmar po/ yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor ljang gu zla gam/ sum̐ las ri rab thig le ser po dang bcas pa so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan par bskyed/ de rnams la rang gi shes pa 'dres pas | rkyen byas nas lugs 'byung gi 'byung ba bzhi'i steng du/ shar shel/ lho bai ḍūr+ya | nub pad+ma rā ga byang gser gyi rang bzhin las grub pa'i ri rab bang rim bzhi pa lcog brgyad kyis brgyan pa'i steng du srung ba'i 'khor lo'i nang du ye shes rin po che'i rang bzhin las grub pa'i yongs su rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor du gyur par skad cig gis blta'o/ /gzhal yas khang bris pa ltar glo 'bur du byas pa'i sgo bzhi pa/ nang nas rim pa bzhin nag po/ dkar po/ ser po/ dmar po/ ljang gu'i rtsig pa lnga dang ldan pa'i steng na rin po che'i pha gu ser pos bskor ba la rnga yab dang*/

zla ba rlung gis bskyod pa dang*/ dril bu g.yer kha dang bcas pa'i dra ba dang*/ dra ba phyed pa 'phyang ba/ pha gu'i steng na rin po che rnam par spel ba'i mda' yab/ de'i steng na rin po che'i dra mig seng ma'i pu shus bskor ba | rtsig pa'i 'og 'dod yon gyi snam bu'i phyogs re rer lha mo bzhi bzhis mchod rdzas du ma 'dzin pa bkod pa/ sgo'i steng gi thad so bzhir ka ba bzhi bzhis bteg pa'i rta babs bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du pad+ma la gnas pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo dang*/ ri dwags dang*/ gdugs dang bcas pa/ nang gi phyogs bzhi'i lha snam shar sngo/ byang ljang*/ nub dmar/ lho ser ba mtshams bzhir bum pa gnyis gnyis te bum pa brgyad kyis mdzes par byas shing*/ ka ba brgyad kyis bteg pa'i gdung mig mangs ris su bres pas 'dod yon gyi bar non pa/ dbus kyi phubs ni 'khor lo gong ma gong mas phubs pa'i phyir 'og ma 'og mas ma phubs pa'o/ /de'i nang du mchod rten zlum po bang rim bzhi pa lta bu'i 'khor lo rim pa bzhi gnas te/ phyi rol sku'i 'khor lo dkar po 'khor los mtshan pa'i ra ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phubs can/ bar ma gsung gi 'khor lo dmar po pad+mas mtshan pa'i ra ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phubs can | nang ma thugs kyi 'khor lo sngon po rdo rjes mtshan pa'i ra ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phubs can/ thams cad kyang rtsibs brgyad pa/ 'og gzh-i'i kha dog sngon po'o/ /lte ba bde chen gyi 'khor lo sna tshogs pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa gri gug gis mtshan pa'i ra ba dang*/ ka ba dang*/ gdung dang*/ thog phubs dang bcas pa dbus phyur bur phubs pa'i steng du rdo rje phyed pa'i tog gis brgyan pa ste/ dwangs shing thogs pa med pa'i 'od zer sna tshogs kun tu 'khrugs pa'o | | lha'i gnas sum cu so bdun po thams cad du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du dbus su 'jigs byed pho mo'i gdan dang*/

'khor rnams la yi dwags kyi gdan bsam mo/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo'i ¡Ã phyi rol ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· phyi'am nang ) du dur khrod brgyad gnas te/ shar du drag tu gtum pa/ byang du tshang tshing 'khrigs pa/ nub tu 'ur 'ur 'bar ba/ lhor 'jigs su rung ba/ mer nags tshal phun sum tshogs pa/ srin por mun pa mi bzadapa/ rlung du ki li ki la'i sgra sgrogs pa/ dbang ldan du ha ha dgod pa'i dur khrod do/ /de nyid kyi rim pas brgya byin/ gnod sbyin/ chu lha/ gshin rje/ me lha/ srin po/ rlung lha/ dbang ldan te phyogs skyong brgyad dang*/ shi ri sha a shwat+thā/ a ¡Ã ko la/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· shwa ka ) tsu ta | ka rañja/ la ta bar ka ti/ par ti par ta/ bha ṭa ste shing chen po brgyad dang*/ de rnams la brten pa'i sgo mtshams ma rnams kyi gzugs 'dzin pa drag gtum skyong ba la sogs pa'i zhing skyong brgyadadang*/ nor rgyas/ 'jog po/ stobs kyi rgyu/ pad+ma | hu lun ta/ rigs ldan/ dung skyong*/ pad+ma chen po ste/ klu brgyad dang*/ sgra grags pa/ rmugs pa/ mun pa can/ kun tu 'khyil pa/ gang ba 'bab pa/ drag po | 'khrigs pa ste/ sprin chen po brgyad dang*/ gzhan yang chu bo chen po brgyad/ me chen po brgyad/ mchod rten chen pa ོ brgyad gnas shing*/ grub pa thob pa'i dpa' po dang*/ rnal 'byor ma dang*/ 'dre dang*/ srin po dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ ro dang*/ ro langs dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ sha za dang*/ ce spyang la sogs pas yongs su gang ba'i dur khrod kyis yongs su bskor bar bsam mo// // gnyis pa brten pa lha bskyed pa la gnyis las/ rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa bskyed pa'i phyir/ gdan dbus ma'i steng du ā li phrag gnyis las nya gang ba'i zla ba me long lta bu'i ye shes/ de'i steng du kā li ya ra la wa ḍa ḍha dang bcas pa phrag gnyis las nyi ma mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ bar du hūm̐ dang am̐ las rdo rje dang gri gug dkar po hūm̐ dang am̐ gis mtshan pa so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/

gcig tu gyur pa bya ba nan tan gyi ye shes/ de las sku yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes te rnam pa ni 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa dang 'dra la/ kha dog ni dkar po/ rtsa zhal dkar zhing g.yas gnag par bskyed nas/ yab kyi gsang gnas hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa bu gar bh+yaṃ gis mtshan pa/ yum gyi mkha' a las pad+ma as mtshan pa bskyed de/ snyoms par zhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde ba chen pos yab yum 'od du zhu nas byang chub kyi sems kyi thig ler gyur par bsam | gnyis pa 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa la bzhi las/ bsnyen pa ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ oṃ ma hā su kha badz+ra satwa dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥsu ra ti s+t+waṃ dṛ sh+ya hoḥ zhes pa'i sngags kyis mgrin gcig tu bskul bas/ thig le yongs su gyur pa hūm̐ dang am̐ las rdo rje dang gri gug hūm̐ dang am̐ gis mtshan par gyur/ de zhu ba las byung ba'i 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa chen por bzhengs te/ de'ang zhal bzhi phyag bcu gnyis pa rtsa ba'i zhal sngo ba g.yon ljang rgyab ser g.yas dkar ba/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ 'og ma gnyis kyis glang po che'i ko rlon gos su gyon pa/ g.yas kyi gsum pas ḍā ma ru/ bzhi pas dgra s+t+wa/ lnga pas mdung rtse gsum pa/ drug pas gri gug g.yon gyi gsum pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭ+wāṃ ga bzhi pas rdo rje'i zhags pa/ lnga pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa/ drug pas tshangs pa'i mgo bo gdong bzhi pa 'dzin pa'o/ / sgrub thabs kyi mchod brjod las g.yas kyi gri gug nas smos pa ni g.yon nas bskor ba la dgongs shing*/ gzhan go rim cung zad mi 'dra ba ni rgyud tha dad kyi dgongs pa'o/ /mi mgo skam po lnga lngas dbu brgyan zhing*/ rlon pa lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan pa/

stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs grol ba/ ral pa'i thor gtsug gi steng na yid bzhin gyi nor bu rin po che dang*/ g.yon na tshes gcig gi zla bas dbu la brgyan pa/ zhabs g.yas brkyang pas dus mtshan dmar po'i nu ma'i steng nas mnan zhing*/ g.yon bskum pas 'jigs byed nag po'i mgo bo bltabs nas mnan pa/ de'i pang na yum rdo rje phag mo sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yon pas khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud cing g.yas pa'i gri gug dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub nam mkha' la phyar nas phyogs bcur bsdigs pa/ spyan gsum pa/ skra grol ba/ gcer bu rus pa'i rgyan lnga 'chang zhing*/ mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang | skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ zhabs g.yon brkyang zhing g.yas pas yab la 'khril ba gnyis ka'ang mnyam par sbyor zhing ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbu na bzhugs par bsam mo/ /de nas rtsa ba'i zhal nas g.yon skor gyis/ zhal re re la dmigs nas/ oṃ suṃ bha ni suṃ bha hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gri h+na gri h+na hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ gri h+na pa ya gri h+na pa ya hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ā na ya ho bha ga wāṃ

¡Ã badz+ra ( ¡¶ lu ¡· bid+ya rā dza ) hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas zhal rnams byin gyis brlab bo ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + de ni lugs las zlog pa'o/ / ces so/ / ) / /de nas sku ril po la dmigs nas/ oṃ dharma dhā tu swa bhā wa ād+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas sku byin gyis brlab bo/ /gnyis pa nye bar sgrub pa ni gnas rnams su zla ba'i gdan bsams nas/ de rnams kyi steng du/ snying gar oṃ ha rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po/ mgo bo la oṃ na ma hi rnam snang ser po/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ swā hā hu pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dmar po/ phrag pa gnyis su oṃ bau ṣa ṭa he dpal he ru ka nag po/ mig gnyis su oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hoḥrdo rje nyi ma dmar ser/ yan lag thams cad la oṃ phaṭa ham̐ rta mchog ljang gu ste dpa' bo'i go cha dang*/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ rdo rje phag mo dmar mo/ snying gar oṃ ham̐ yoṃ gshin rje ma sngon mo/ khar oṃ hriṃ mam̐ rmongs byed ma dkar mo/ mgo la oṃ hreṃ hriṃ skyod byed ma ser mo/ spyi gtsug tu oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ skrag byed ma ljang gu/ yan lag thams cad la oṃ phaṭa phaṭa tsaṇ+ḍi ka dud kha ste dpa' mo'i go cha bkod la/ yab kyi gnas su yum dang yum gyi gnas su yab dang gnyis su med par bsam mo/ /gzhan yang yab kyi thugs kar ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + zla ba la ) hūm̐ thugs rdo rje sngon po/ lkog mar oṃ hrī ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa gsung rdo rje dmar po | dpral bar oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + badz+ra ḍa ki ni ) hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba ra swā hā sku rdo rje dkar po/ yum gyi snying gar oṃ sar+b+ba bud+dha ḍā ki nī badz+ra war+ṇ+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ ( ¡¶ lu ¡· + hūm̐ ) phaṭa swā hā/ thugs rdo rje sngon po/ lkog mar oṃ tsau rī hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa gsung rdo rje dmar po/ dpral bar oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ) swā hā/ sku rdo rje dkar po/ gnyis ka'i spyi bor am̐ dkar po rnam snang*/

mgrin par āḥdamar po 'od dpag med/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po mi bskyod pa/ lte bar swā ser po rin 'byung*/ brlar hā ljang gu don yod grub pa ste yi ge'i rnam pa de rnams ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - rnams ) nyid lha'i ngo bor bsam mo/ /gsum pa sgrub pa ni/ lus kyi 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyes su bskor/ ngag tu oṃ phaiṃ zhes brjod | sems kyis snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rang dang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs*/ snga ma ltar mchod/ dgug pa dang*/ gzhug pa dang*/ bcing ba dang*/ dbang du bya bar bsams la dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥyo ga shud+dha s+sarba dharmā yā+o ga shud+dho3haṃ zhes brjod pas gnyis su med par gyur pa bsam mo/ /bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po ni snga ma ltar dbang gi lha rigs lnga yab yum spyan drang*/ mchod pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñca tu māṃ zhes gsol ba gdab pas sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis khrus bgyi'o/ /oṃ sar+b+ba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing ye shes kyi chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas yab la mi bskyod pa dang*/ yum la rnam snang gis dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /dang po sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin to/ /gnyis pa dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog la bzhi las dang po mngal du bskyed pa ni/ 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa yab yum gyi mkha' gsang snga ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas snyoms par zhugs pas zag pa med pa'i bde bas lus gang bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a nu rā ga na badz+ra swa bhā wa ād+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes pas byin gyis brlab/ de nas bde ba'i sgra dang snying ga'i hūm̐ gi 'od kyis bskul nas phyogs bcu'i bde bar

gshegs pa spyan drang*/ yab yum gnyis ka'i smin mtshams sam spyi gtsug nas zhugs/ a wa dhū tī'i lam nas brgyud/ lte bar rjes su chags pa'i me dang*/ gtum mo'i mes bzhu/ yab kyi thig le dang yum gyi rak+ta 'dres pa las byung ba'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs pa bha gar blta'o/ / gnyis pa 'byin pa ni phyi'i he ru ka'i snying ga chos kyi 'khor lo'i lte bar hūm̐/ shar nas brtsams te phyogs bzhir bzlog pa'i rim pas lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tām̐/ mtshams su khams bdud rtsi 'bab pa'i rtsa bzhi/ phyi skor la hūm̐ ring po brgyad/ spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas rnams su pu dzā au a go rā de ma/ ka o tri ko ka la kā hi/ pre gṛ sau su na si ma ku/ zhes pa'i yi ge rnams gsal btab nas/ 'og rlung 'then pa'i sbyor bas yum gyi bha ga nas gtso bo/ rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ la thim pas yum dang bcas pa'i nang gi he ru kar gyur/ gtso mo'ang yum gyi thugs kar drangs nas ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + lte ba'i ) am̐ la thim pas yum 'ba' zhig tu gyur par bsam/ de nas snying po rnal 'byor ma bzhi rim pa bzhin du yar drangs/ snying ga'i phyogs kyi yi ge bzhi la rim pa bzhin reg pas yi ge rnams nang gi rnal 'byor ma bzhir gyur/ yar byon pa rnams so so'i gnas su spros nas phyi'i bde chen gyi 'khor lo'i phyogs bzhir gnas par bsgoms la rim gyis gsal btab ste/ nang dang phyi'i shar du mkha' 'gro ma sngo skya/ byang du lā mā ljang ser/ nub tu khaṇ+ḍa ro hā dmar ser/ lhor gzugs can ma dkar ser te/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro las phyed gzugs su bshad pa ltar ram/ yang na sngo ba la skya ba'i mdangs chags pa la sogs par bzhed de/ zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa g.yas pa rnams kyis gri gug nam mkha' la phyar zhing*/ g.yon pa rnams kyis glang po dang*/ ce spyang dang*/ mi dang ¡Ã wa ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· ba glang ) dang bcas pa'i thod pa khrag gis gang ba bsnams pa yin la/

gzhan rgyan dang cha lugs ni rdo rje phag mo dang 'dra ba'o | | yang bha ga'i thod pa bzhi po yar drangs/ snying ga'i mtshams kyi rtsa bzhi la reg pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba bzhir gyur/ yar byon pa rnams so so'i gnas rnams su spros nas bde chen gyi grwa bzhir dgod do/ /de nas dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma rnams spro bar bya ste/ de'ang bha ga nas lha rnams yar drangs | spyi bo la sogs pa'i gnas so sor byon/ gnas rnams yul nyi shu rtsa bzhir gyur/ khams rnams dpa' bo rnams su gyur/ rtsa rnams rnal 'byor mar gyur nas de nyid du 'khod pa dang*/ bha ga nas phyung ba rnams gnas so so nas spros phyi'i gnas so sor 'khod pa thams cad la sbyar zhing rim pa bzhin bsgom par bya ste/ spyi bo dang thugs kyi 'khor lo'i shar gyi rtsibs su/ pul+lī ra mā la yar khaṇ+ḍa ka pā li dang rab tu gtum mo/ spyi gtsug dang byang rtsibs dzā lan+dha rar ma hā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ rna ba g.yas pa dang nub rtsibs u ḍi ya nar kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma/ ltag pa dang lho rtsibs su arbu dar mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma/ rna ba g.yon pa dang shar lhor go dā wa rir su ra wī ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ smin phrag dang lho nub tu rā me shwa rir 'od dpag tu med pa dang mi'u thung ma/ mig dang nub byang de wī ko ṭar rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ phrag pa dang byang shar ma la war rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma ste thugs kyi 'khor lo kha dog sngon po nam mkha' la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs kyi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo'o/ /mchan khung dang gsung gi 'khor lo'i shar gyi rtsibs kā ma rū par aṃ gu ri dang*/ e ra wa ti/ nu ma dang byang rtsibs o trair rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ lte ba dang nub rtsibs tri sha ku ner dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/

sna rtse dang lho rtsibs ko sa lar rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma/ kha dang shar lho ka ling gar rab tu bzang po dang sh+yā ma de wī/ mgrin pa dang lho nub lam+pa kar rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/ snying dang nub byang kāñcir 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ 'dom par dang byang shar hi ma la yar mig mi bzang dang kha gā na sta ེ gsung gi 'khor lo kha dog dmar po sa la spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa gsung gi gsang ba bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngo bo'o/ /mtshan ma dang sku'i 'khor lo'i shar gyi rtsibs pre ta pu rir stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ 'og sgo dang byang rtsibs gṛ ha de war rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hā/ brla dang nub rtsibs sau rāṣ+tar rta mgrin dang shoṇ+ḍi nī/ byin pa dang lho rtsibs su war+ṇa dwī par nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma | sor mo dang shar lho nā ga rar dpal he ru ka dang shin tu dpa' mo/ bol gong dang lho nub sin+dur pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ mthe bong dang nub byang ma ror rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/ pus mo dang byang shar ku lun tar rdo rja ེ sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo ste sku'i 'khor lo kha dog dkar po sa 'og na spyod pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs pa/ sku'i gsang ba bsam gyi mi khyab pa'i ngo bo'o/ /dpa' bo thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa spyan gsum drag po'i gzugs can/ rgyan dang cha lugs he ru ka dang mtshungs pa / dpa' mo thams cad zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa rgyan dang cha lugs thams cad rdo rje phag mo dang tshul mtshungs pa/ thams cad gnyis su med pa'i sbyor ba la brtson zhing sku las 'od zer 'bar ba/ ro dang nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs par blta'o/ /lha'i rnam pa rnams lo hi pa'i gzhung dang mthun par phyag bzhi par bsgoms kyang 'gal ba med par bsam mo/

/de nas bha ga'i sgo mtshams ma brgyad rim pa bzhin rdo rje'i lam nas yar drangs/ thugs ka'i hūm̐ ring po brgyad la reg pas nang gi sgo mtshams ma brgyad du gyur/ yar byon pa rnams so so'i gnas nas phyir spros/ dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i phyogs mtshams brgyad du 'khod par bsams la rim gyis gsal gdab ste/ nang dang phyi'i shar du kha gdong ma/ byang du 'ug gdong ma/ nub tu khyi gdong ma/ lhor phag gdong ma rnams snying po'i rnal 'byor ma'i mdog can sgo srung bar byed pa'o/ /mer gshin rje brtan ma g.yas sngo/ g.yon ser/srin por gshin rje pho nya ma g.yas ser | g.yon dmar/ rlung du gshin rje mche ba ma g.yas dmar/ g.yon ljang*/ dbang ldan du gshin rje 'joms ma g.yas ljang*/ g.yon sngo ba/ thams cad kyang g.yas gri gug g.yon thod pa khrag can 'dzin cing zhabs g.yon brkyang pas ro la gnas pas/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can rus pa'i rgyan lnga dang ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + ldan pa ) mi mgo skam po lnga'i dbu rgyan dang*/ ¡Ã skom po ( ¡¶ lu ¡· rlon pa ¡¶ zha ¡· - skom po ) lnga bcu'i do shal 'chang ba/ drag mo shin tu khros pa'o/ /de nas bha ga'i srung 'khor dang bcas pa'i rten gyi dkyil 'khor yar drangs pas rang gi lus kyi rten khog pa nang gi dkyil 'khor du gyur par bsams te/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje | rkang mthil rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ rtsib logs rdo rje'i ra ba/ pags pa rdo rje'i gur dang bla re/ ba spu mda'i dra ba/ skra sen ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung 'khor dang | rkang mthil rlung*/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ sgal tshigs ri rab | mgo bo ri rab stod kyi cha/ lus 'dom gang gru bzhi/ gzhal yas khang gru bzhi/ snying ga nas 'byung ba bzhi'i rlung rgyu ba sgo bzhi/ mig la sogs pa gzhal yas khang gi rgyan/ rkang rnams ka ba'i tshogs te rten gyi dkyil 'khor gsal bar dmigs nas yar byon pa'i rten gyi dkyil 'khor sku'i cha thams cad nas spros pas phyi'i dkyil 'khor la thim par bsam mo/

/gsum pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ sarba bī ra yo gi nī kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa ād+ma ko3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas bdag gis bsgoms pa'i phyi nang gi dkyil 'khor gyi lha tshogs 'dzam bu'i gling na bzhugs pa'i sprul pa'i sku/ 'og min na bzhugs pa'i longs sku'i tshogs gsum dbyer med par gyur nas gnyis su med pa'i rdo rje'i rang bzhin bdag yin snyam du bsam pa lan gsum bya/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dha s+sarba dharmā badz+ra shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rang bzhin rnam par dag pa bdag yin snyam du bsam mo/ /bzhi pa go cha bcing zhing byin gyis brlab pa ni/ phyi nang gi lha rnams la yi ge rnams snga ma bzhin du dgod de/ dkyil 'khor rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin to/ /gsum pa las rgyal mchog gi ting nge 'dzin la bzhi las ye shes pa dgug pa ni/ sbyor ba'i skabs ltar spyan drangs shing mchod nas/ phyi dang lus kyi dkyil 'khor la bstim mo/ /gnyis pa dbang bskur ba'ang snga ma ltar phyi nang gi lha rnams la dbang bskur/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas gtso bo la mi bskyod pa/ yum la rnam snang*/ mkha' 'gro ma la mi bskyod pa/ lā mā la don yod grub pa/ khaṇ+ḍa ro hā la 'od dpag med/ gzugs can ma la rin chen 'byung ldan | gzhan rnams kyi dam tshig gi 'khor lo'i bar shar nas g.yon bskor du snga ma'i rim pa/ shar lho nas g.yas skor du rnam snang nas don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /'di slon dpon bhu ri pa'i dgongs pa dang mthun zhes gsung ngo*/ /gsum pa mchod pa ni phyi nang yid las byung bas mchod nas rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod par bya'o/ /bzhi pa dag pa rjes su dran pa ni lam la som nyi spang ba'i phyir/ lus rjes su dran pa ni mkha' 'gro ma/ tshor ba rjes su dran pa ni lā mā/ chos rjes su dran pa ni khaṇ+ḍa ro hā/ sems rjes su dran pa ni gzugs can ma/

'dun pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni khaṇ+ḍa ka pā la dang rab tu gtum mo/ brtson 'grus kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni ma hā kaṃ ka la dang gtum pa'i mig can ma/ dpyod pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni kaṃ ka la dang 'od ldan ma | sems kyi rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa ni mche ba rnam par gtsigs pa dang sna chen ma | dad pa'i dbang po ni su ra wī ri dang brtan pa'i blo can ma/ brtson 'grus kyi dbang po ni 'od dpag med dang mi'u thung ma/ dran pa'i dbang po ni rdo rje'i 'od dang laṅka'i dbang phyug ma/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang po ni rdo rje'i sku dang shing grib ma | shes rab kyi dbang po ni aṃ gu ri dang e rā ba tī/ dad pa'i stobs ni rdo rje ral pa can dang 'jigs byed chen mo/ brtson 'grus kyi stobs ni dpa' bo chen po dang rlung gi shugs can ma/ dran pa'i stobs ni rdo rje hūm̐ mdzad dang chang 'thung ma | ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs ni rab tu bzang po dang sh+yā ma de wī/ shes rab kyi stobs ni rdo rje bzang po dang shin tu bzang mo/

ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub gyi yan lag ni 'jigs byed chen po dang rta rna ma/ brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni mig mi bzang dang kha gā na/ dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni stobs po che dang 'khor lo'i shugs can ma/ shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rin chen rdo rje dang khaṇ+ḍa ro hā/ chos rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni rta mgrin dag shoṇ+ḍi nī/ dran pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni nam mkha'i snying po dang 'khor lo'i go cha ma/ btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ni dpal he ru ka dang shin tu bzang mo'o/ /yang dag pa'i lta ba ni pad+ma gar gyi dbang phyug dang stobs chen ma/ yang dag pa'i rtogs pa ni rnam par snang mdzad dang 'khor los sgyur ma/ yang dag pa'i ngag ni rdo rje sems dpa' dang brtson 'grus chen mo/ yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ni khwa gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i 'tsho ba ni 'ug gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i rtsol ba ni khyi gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i dran pa ni phag gdong ma/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni dpal he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mo'o/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa ni ya ( ¡¶ lu ¡· a ) ma dā ti ( ¡¶ lu ¡· ḍa ) / dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par bsrung ba ni gshin rje pho nya ma/ mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams yang dag par spong ba ni gshin rje mche ba ma/ mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams mi bskyed pa ni gshin rje 'joms ma'o/ /zhes brjod cing lam gyi chos rnams lha'i rnam par dran par bya'o/ /lha la som nyi spong na mkha' 'gro ma ni lus rjes su dran pa'o | | zhes pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis brjod cing lha rnams lam gyi ngo bor dran par bya'o/ /blo mchog tu gyur pa rnams kyis ni bdag gi blo la snang ba'i phyi dang nang gi lha sum cu so bdun po 'di nyid byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun gyi ngo bo

( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + nyid ) yin la byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu so bdun yang lha sum cu so bdun gyi ngo bor rnam par gnas ¡Ã pa ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· pa'o ) zhes brjod cing thun mong la dmigs pa'i dag pa dran par bya'o/ /de nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur dmigs la rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag go /de'ang blo sbyang ba'i phyir dang po gtso bo 'ba' zhig la dmigs/ de nas 'khor gyi lha rnams la rim pa bzhin du dmigs/ de nas rten gzhal yas khang la dmigs / de nas dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa la dmigs/ de nas phyi rol snod bcud kyi 'jig rten thams cad bdag gis bsgoms pa'i dkyil 'khor dang mtshungs par blta zhing de'ang dmigs pa'i yul rim gyis rgya bskyed de/ mthar nam mkha'i mthas gtugs pa chos kyi dbyings kyis klas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad lha'i dkyil 'khor du blta zhing mnyam par bzhag go /gang gi tshe snod bcud dang bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa me long gi gzugs brnyan snang ba ltar gsal zhing*/ rdzogs la ma 'dres pa cig car du snang zhing mnyam par 'jog pa dang*/ de las ldang ba dang*/ spro ba dang*/ bsdu ba dang*/ go skabs chung ngu rgya chen po dmigs pa dang*/ shin tu yangs pa'i rgya khyon rnam pa chung ngus khyab par 'gengs pa la sogs pa ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du dbang 'byor par gyur pa de'i tshe/ bskyed pa'i rim pa ting nge 'dzin brtan par gyur pa yin te/ thun mong gi las sgrub pa la thogs pa med cing*/ mchog gi go 'phang la yang nye bar gyur pa yin no/ /bskyed pa'i rim pa'o/ /rdzogs pa'i rim pa ni/ bsgom pa'i tshul mi 'dra ba du ma zhig gsungs kyang 'dir gtso bor gyur pa dpyid kyi thig le dang*/ he ru ka dang rdo rje phag mo kha sbyor ba bsgom pa'i tshul na ི/ bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgoms pa'i mthar/ lus kyi 'phrul 'khor dang

ldan pas rlung nang du 'dren pa dang bstun nas/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor ma lus pa sna'i bu ga gnyis kyi lam nas drangs la snying ga'i hūm̐ la bstim/ yum yang drangs te lte ba'i am̐ la bstim/ yab nyid kyang zhal gcig phyag gnyis par dmigs pa'i lus kyi dbus kyi cha la a wa dhū tī phra zhing gsal ba drang ba/ g.yas su ra sa nā dmar po me'i rang bzhin kā li'i rnam pa'i rak+tas gang ba/ g.yon du la la nā dkar po chu'i rang bzhin ā li'i rnam pa'i thig les gang ba/ dbu ma la brten pa'i lte ba sprul pa'i 'khor lo 'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi pa'i lte bar phag mo'i ngo bo me'i rang bzhin am̐ dmar mo mgo gyen du lta ba/ nang skor 'dab ma brgyad la a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha phyi skor rtsa 'dab lnga bcu rtsa drug la ā li kā li dang dbyangs kyi ring po drug dang bcas pa dgod/ snying gar dbu ma la brten pa'i chos kyis 'khor lo rtsa 'dab brgyad pa'i lte bar shes pa'i rten rtsa dmar po mthe bo yongs kyi tshad dang mnyam pa/ thur du sor phyed dang gsum 'phyang ba'i dbus su he ru ka'i ngo bo byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin hūm̐ ba mo'i mdog mgo thur du blta ba dang*/ phyogs kyi 'dab ma bzhir oṃ trām̐ hrīḥ.aḥmatshams bzhir lam̐ mam̐ pam̐ tām̐ dgod | hūm̐ dang am̐ gnyis dbu mas zung 'brel par bsams la/ 'og gi las kyi rlung bskyod pas/ lte ba'i am̐ cher bskul nas am̐ las me'i 'od rta rnga brgyar bshags pa'i tshad dang mnyam pa dbu ma'i lam nas song nas hūm̐ la bsnun pas | hūm̐ las byang chub kyi sems kyi rgyun dkar po snga ma'i tshad dang mnyam pa lam de nyid nas babs nas/ am̐ la thim pas gzi brjid phun sum tshogs par gyur par bsam mo/ /de'ang dbugs 'byung ba'i tshe/ me gyen du rgyu ba la dmigs pas ra sa nā'i nus pa stobs su gyur nas / lus drod kyis gang bas rnam par rtog pa bsregs par bsam/ rlung 'jug pa'i tshe khams thur du babs pa la dmigs pas la la nā'i nus pa stobs su gyur te/

lus thams cad bde bas gang bar bsam | rlung gnas pa'i tshe 'bar ba dang 'dzag pa ro gcig tu gyur pas dbu ma'i nus pa stobs su gyur te/ bde ba dang mi rtog pa zung du chud par bsam mo | | tshul 'di nyid la goms par byas pas ting nge 'dzin gyi khyad par rnyed pa'i tshe rlung gi rnal 'byor dang*/ 'phrul 'khor gyi khyad par gyis kyang bogs dbyung bar bya'o/ /shin tu goms pas du ba la sogs pa mtshan ma rnams kyang 'byung zhing yang dag pa'i ye shes kyang skye bar 'gyur ro/ /rnal 'byor gnyis las byung ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi rgyun des he ru ka'i go 'phang la sbyor ba byed/ rdzogs rim bsgom pa'i tshul rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /mnyam par bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor ro/ /bzlas pa ji ltar bya ba'i tshul ni snying ga'i hūm̐ las phyi'i dkyil 'khor rdzogs par spros la/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas gsal gdab/ de nas gtso bo la sogs pa yab rnams kyi thugs ka'i sa bon las ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· + sngags ) 'od zer gyi rnam pa 'phros/ yab kyi zhal dang*/ yum ky-i zhal dang*/ bha ga dang*/ rdo rje'i lam nas 'khor ba dang*/ rnal 'byor ma bcu gnyis kyi ni thugs ka'i sa bon la g.yon skor du 'khor bar bsams te/ kha dog ni las dang rjes su mthun pa'o/ /sngags kyi tshig ni oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti la sogs pa yab kyi rtsa sngags/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he he ru ru kaṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ḍā ki nī dzā la saṃ ba ra swā hā snying po'o/ /oṃ hrīḥ ha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa nye ba'i snying po'o/ /oṃ sum+bha la sogs pa ni zhal byin gyis brlab pa dang*/ las kyi sngags so/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa ti badz+ra pā ra hī la sogs pa yum gyi rtsa sngags so/ /oṃ sar+b+ba bud+dha ḍā ki nī ye badz+ra war+ṇ+ṇa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + phaṭa ) swā hā/ yum gyi snying po'o/ /oṃ badz+ra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'o | | oṃ tsau ri hum̐ hūm̐ phaṭa nye ba'i

( ¡¶ zha ¡· + snying po'i ) snying po'o/ /de dag las gang mos pa zla ba'am/ ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + badz+ra warna ṇa ) rtsa sngags gnyis/ snying po gnyis/ nye snying gnyis | ¡Ã go ca ( ¡¶ zha ¡· go cha ¡¶ lu ¡· cho ga ) gnyis te/ rin chen bzhi la bzlas pa byas te/ sa steng na ni rin chen bzhi/ /phreng ba'i sngags ni dam par brjod/ / ces gsungs so/ /de nas 'khor rnams kyi sngags kya nga bzla'o / /sngags rnams gzhung gi cha mang po las 'byung ba'i phyir ma bris so/ /bzlas pa'i rnal 'byor ro// gtor ma'i bya ba ni/ 'das pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa gnyis las snga ma ni gtor ma legs par bshams la/ sum+bha dang swa bhā was bsang zhing sbyangs nas stong pa'i ngang las yam̐ dang ram̐ las rlung dang me'i steng du āḥlas thod pa dum bu gsum pa shin tu yangs pa'i nang du/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng shar/ lho/ nub | byang*/ dbus su/ go ku da ha na las ba lang*/ khyi/ rta/ glang po che/ mi'i sha lnga dang*/ de'i steng du shar/ dbus/ nub/ byang*/ lhor/ bi mu shu ma ra las dri chen/ dri chu/ byang sems/ klad pa/ rak+ta ste bdud rtsi lnga/ de'i steng du dbus dang shar nas g.yas skor gyis/ hūm̐ ām̐ tram̐ hrīḥ.aḥrnams chos kyi dbyings/ me long lta bu/ mnyam pa nyid/ so sor rtog pa/ bya ba grub pa ste/ ye shes lnga'i ngo bor bsam ma/ /de'i steng du bdud rtsi lnga'i rang bzhin oṃ dkar po mgo thur du lta ba/de'i steng du byang chub kyi sems kyi rang bzhin kha ṭ+wāṃ ga mgo thur du lta ba hūm̐ gis mtshan pa bsams nas/ hūm̐ las 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas rlung g.yos pas me sbar/ des sha lnga bdud rtsi lnga dang*/ ye shes lnga ( ¡¶ zha ¡· + dang bcas pa ) bzhu zhing bskol ba'i rlangs pa gyen du song bas/ oṃ dang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga las bdud rtsa'i rgyun babs | yang kha ṭ+wāṃ ga las byung ba'i 'od zer rlangs pa dang bcas pa phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kya ི ye shes kyi bdud rtsi thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba'i rnam pas bkug nas gtor ma la thim/

kha ṭ+wāṃ ga oṃ dang bcas pa'ang lhung nas thams cad ro gcig tu 'dres pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor dmigs la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes yang yang brjod cing byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar skad cig gis rten dang brten par bcas pa'i lha drug cu rtsa gnyis kyi ¡Ã dkyil 'khor ( ¡¶ zha ¡· - dkyil 'khor ) dmigs la/ gtso bo'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas dur khrod brgyad la phog pas/ dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs pa brgyad du gyur te/ ye shes pa dang ro gcig tu byas la rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor dang dkyil 'khor dgu'i lha rnams kyi zhal nas 'od kyi sbu gu byung nas gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye ba'i phyag rgya byas la/ oṃ badz+ra ā ral+li ho dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḍā ki nī sa ma ya s+t+waṃ ¡Ã dṛ sh+ya hoḥ/ oṃ ( ¡¶ zha ¡·¡¶ lu ¡· oṃ ) badz+ra ḍā ki nī kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ i maṃ bha liṃ/ bhuñja tha/ pi pa tha/ mā ma kar+yaṃ/ sā dhā ya oṃ āḥhūm̐ phaiṃ phaiṃ swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis bstabs nas/ lha'i sngags yongs su rdzogs pas kyang dbul bar bya'o/ /gzhung las zor yang ba'i phyir sngags kyi bzlas pa dang gtor ma bstabs pa'i sngags dus gcig tu gsungs so/ /de nas phyi dang nang dang yid las byung ba'i mchod pas mchod nas/ yab dang yum gyi rkang pa brgyad pa gnyis kyis bstod la/ srid dang zhi ba mnyam par chags pa 'joms shing yang dag rtog pa bcom/ khyed kyis dngos po thams cad mkha' dang mnyam pa'i bdag nyid gzigs par ldan/ / mgon po thugs rje'i ljid ( ¡¶ lu ¡· char ) kyis yang dag brlan pa'i thugs kyi chus | | lha mo rnams kyis bdag la shin tu mdzes ( ¡¶ zha ¡· rjes ) brtser mdzad du gsol | | zhes pa'i tshig gis gsol ba gdab bo/ /'jig rten pa'i gtor ma ni mkha' 'gro spyi'i gtor ma'i cho gas btang ngo*/ /mthar dge ba bsngo/ yi ge brgya pas cho ga lhag chad kha bskang*/
